field.label: Group
field.help: The list group this source belongs to. Clients are pointed at group names on the Client Groups tab; a list in a group no client uses is downloaded but never applied.

field.label: URL or Path
field.help: The URL to download, or the absolute path of a local file. Leave empty when the entries are typed in below.

field.label: Entries
field.help: One entry per line, used when the source is set to "Entered below". An entry can be a domain, a wildcard such as *.example.com, or a regular expression wrapped in slashes.
